author: NPR Music
description:
The 2026 Tiny Desk Contest closed 2 weeks ago with more than 6,000 entries. While our judges review, we're sharing some standouts here. Discover new artists to love by following along with our #DeskOfTheDay features.

Our first #DeskOfTheDay is "KIRA" by @lisachiodo  from New York!

Watch the full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y3hVDujXbvgThe 2026 Tiny Desk Contest is presented by  @CapitalOne and supported by  @Rivian
title: #DeskOfTheDay: "KIRA," Lisa Chiodo
